mapper.sql: COUNT(br.id) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.status_code = 'INCOMPLETE'), 0) AS incomplete_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.status_code = 'ASSISTED'), 0) AS assisted_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.status_code = 'INDEPENDENT'), 0) AS independent_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.status_code IS NULL), 0) AS unclassified_count
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.id) AS observation_course_count, COUNT(br.id) AS behavior_record_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.detail_saved = TRUE), 0) AS abc_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(cr.overall_remark), '') IS NOT NULL THEN cr.id END) AS remark_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT relation.standard_number) FROM behavior_record goal_record JOIN class_record goal_class ON goal_class.id = goal_record.class_record_id JOIN behavior_training_goal relation ON relation.behavior_code = goal_record.behavior_code WHERE goal_class.student_id = #{studentId} AND goal_class.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) AS training_goal_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.status_code = 'INCOMPLETE'), 0) AS incomplete_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.status_code = 'ASSISTED'), 0) AS assisted_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.status_code = 'INDEPENDENT'), 0) AS independent_count, COALESCE(SUM(br.id IS NOT NULL AND br.status_code IS NULL), 0) AS unclassified_count FROM class_record cr LEFT JOIN behavior_record br ON br.class_record_id = cr.id WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT bt.code, bt.label, FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN behavior_type bt ON bt.code = br.behavior_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY bt.code, bt.label ORDER BY total_count DESC, bt.code

SELECT cr.record_date AS date, FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY cr.record_date ORDER BY cr.record_date

SELECT ct.code, ct.label, FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN course_type ct ON ct.code = cr.course_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY ct.code, ct.label ORDER BY total_count DESC, ct.code

SELECT et.code, et.label, FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id JOIN environment_type et ON et.code = cr.environment_code WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY et.code, et.label ORDER BY total_count DESC, et.code

SELECT function_type.code, function_type.label, CASE function_type.code WHEN 'ATTENTION' THEN 1 WHEN 'ESCAPE' THEN 2 WHEN 'SENSORY' THEN 3 WHEN 'TANGIBLE' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS display_order, COUNT(br.id) AS count FROM behavior_function_type function_type LEFT JOIN ( SELECT behavior.function_code, behavior.id FROM behavior_record behavior JOIN class_record class_row ON class_row.id = behavior.class_record_id WHERE class_row.student_id = #{studentId} AND class_row.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND behavior.detail_saved = TRUE AND behavior.function_code IS NOT NULL ) br ON br.function_code = function_type.code GROUP BY function_type.code, function_type.label ORDER BY display_order, function_type.code

SELECT MAX(cr.record_date) FROM behavior_record br JOIN class_record cr ON cr.id = br.class_record_id WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND br.detail_saved = TRUE AND NULLIF(TRIM(br.behavior_description), '') IS NOT NULL
